visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a light pink cardigan stands before a large traditional Japanese-style gate decorated with giant eyeball lanterns. She smiles broadly, waving her arms in excitement under the bright natural daylight of an outdoor plaza. (2) The camera pans across a wooden structure labeled "妖怪森林" (Monster Forest). Red and white lanterns with painted eyes hang from the eaves, alongside intricate lattice woodwork. The setting is a wooded theme park with lush green trees in the background. (3) Indoors, the woman holds a black smartphone, pointing at its screen while speaking animatedly. She wears a cream-colored tank top and a smart watch. The background shows a blurry retail or information center environment with soft lighting. (4) The woman stands beside a large white and green cat-like mascot wearing a blue yukata. She holds up a small green card with a QR code, pointing to it with her index finger. A large capsule toy machine filled with colorful balls is visible behind them. (5) A screen recording shows a mobile game interface titled "山域探險記". A cartoon cat character is at the center. The woman's manicured nails are seen as she interacts with the touch screen. Yellow buttons and map markers are visible on the UI. (6) Detailed shots show hands holding a bottle and applying liquid to a sand art drawing of various monster characters. The paper has black outlines on a white background. Later, a hand holds the completed colorful sand painting protected by a plastic sleeve. (7) In a brightly lit shop, a shopkeeper in a red and black uniform helps the woman adjust a pink floral yukata. The camera captures close-ups of the woman’s hair being styled into a bun with a wooden comb. (8) The woman takes a selfie in the park using an AR filter that adds a "monster" character overlay to her photo. She is now wearing the pink floral yukata and has a red dot on her forehead. Outdoor food stalls are visible behind her. (9) At a green capsule machine, the woman presses a button and retrieves a green capsule. She opens it to reveal small colorful monster figurines, reacting with a wide, joyful smile. Her expression is one of genuine surprise and delight. (10) The final scene shows the woman sitting on a gray sofa in a cozy wooden cottage. She talks to the camera, flanked by plush monster toys. A window behind her shows two other women eating together in a dimly lit room at night.
